# Everstead: More Than a Home, It's a Community


Tri Pointe Homes


•


September 8, 2026


Share this article


Today’s homebuyers are looking for more than a place to live, they’re searching for communities where they can build connections, enjoy shared spaces and create a lifestyle that truly feels at home. Thoughtfully designed amenities, welcoming spaces and natural surroundings all play an important role in creating a neighborhood where residents can relax, connect and enjoy everyday moments.


Enter[Everstead](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/everstead) by Tri Pointe Homes®. While Everstead is surrounded by peaceful trees and natural beauty, the community provides access to Downtown Raleigh, Wake Forest, and the greater Triangle within easy reach, offering the perfect balance of tranquil living and convenient access to shopping, dining and entertainment. Coming in 2027, these ranch-style single-family homes offer approximately 1,456 to 2,708 square feet of comfortable, versatile living.


Beyond the thoughtful design and excellent location, Everstead offers residents something even more valuable — a true sense of community. When buyers choose an Everstead home, they gain more than just a house, they gain a community equipped with a homeowner’s association (HOA), pool, clubhouse, and even a dog park. This community is designed to make it easier to connect with neighbors, stay active, and enjoy everyday life. Read on to discover how these community features can enhance your lifestyle and make Everstead feel like home.


**Amenities that enhance fitness, connection, and convenience**


**Health & Fitness**


Living a healthy, active lifestyle starts with having opportunities to get outside, stay moving, relax and prioritize overall wellness. At Everstead, these opportunities are just steps from your front door. Residents will have access to planned amenities designed to support physical and mental well-being and make it easier to prioritize healthy habits every day. One of these amenities is the community pool!


Whether you’re looking to relax poolside or fit in a refreshing swim, the community pool offers the perfect place to unwind and stay active. Enjoy the benefits of time spent outdoors, from reducing stress to supporting cardiovascular health, all while having a convenient wellness amenity just steps from home.


Speaking of steps, there is never an excuse not to hit your daily step goal when you live near an outdoor favorite like[Horseshoe Farm Nature Preserve](https://raleighnc.gov/parks-and-recreation/places/horseshoe-farm-nature-preserve) . Here, you can explore 146 acres of natural beauty and peaceful walking trails. Surrounded by trees and scenic landscapes, the preserve provides a peaceful setting to enjoy fresh air, movement and time outdoors.


Everstead prioritizes health and fitness for all who live there, including furry residents. The planned community dog park makes it easy for residents to give their pets plenty of exercise while creating opportunities to meet neighbors and build lasting connections. Whether you're tossing a tennis ball, taking a stroll, or simply catching up with fellow dog owners, it's another space designed to bring the community together.


Beyond the community amenities that support health and fitness, Everstead’s convenient Triangle location provides easy access to nearby healthcare options such as[UNC Health,](https://www.unchealth.org/home)[WakeMed Health & Hospitals](https://www.wakemed.org/) and[Duke Health](https://www.dukehealth.org/) , helping residents prioritize their well-being close to home. From the pool and nearby walking trails to the community dog park, Everstead offers plenty of ways to stay active and improve fitness. Equally valuable are the opportunities to connect with neighbors and build a sense of community through Everstead's homeowners association (HOA) and planned clubhouse.


**Connection**


While spontaneous conversations at the pool or dog park can spark new friendships, community spaces like the clubhouse and organizations such as the HOA give neighbors intentional opportunities to connect, gather, and build lasting relationships.


More than just an amenity, the community clubhouse provides a cozy space where neighbors can connect, relax and enjoy time together. Whether catching up with friends or taking a break from the everyday routine, this shared space offers another opportunity to build relationships and foster the sense of community at Everstead.


The HOA helps ensure those connections continue to thrive by creating a well-maintained, welcoming community for everyone who calls Everstead home. According to the[Foundation for Community Association Research](https://foundation.caionline.org/publications/factbook/statistical-review/) , more than 75 million Americans live in community associations, which help residents manage shared amenities, maintain common areas, and create opportunities for community engagement. Through establishing and upholding neighborhood standards, the HOA helps preserve the beauty and functionality of the community while allowing residents to spend more time enjoying the spaces they love.


**Convenience**


At Everstead, community extends beyond the neighborhood itself. Located in Raleigh, NC and minutes from Downtown Wake Forest and the greater Triangle, residents can enjoy the perfect balance of a close-knit atmosphere and easy access to everyday conveniences.


Whether it’s grabbing a coffee, enjoying a meal with friends or exploring local shops, Wake Forest offers a variety of destinations that make everyday outings feel more fun! Nearby favorites include the charming downtown area, where residents can discover locally owned restaurants, like[Over the Falls](https://www.otfalls.com/) and[George’s Pizzeria](https://georgespizzawf.com/) , and community events that bring the town’s welcoming atmosphere to life.


For outdoor enthusiasts, the area offers even more opportunities to enjoy the natural beauty surrounding Everstead. In addition to Horseshoe Farm Nature Preserve, nearby destinations like[Joyner Park](https://www.wakeforestnc.gov/parks-recreation-cultural-resources/parks-facilities/e-carroll-joyner-park) provide scenic walking trails, open green spaces and chances to spend more time outdoors year-round.


Everyday essentials are also within easy reach throughout Wake Forest and North Raleigh, with convenient access to grocery stores like[Publix,](https://www.publix.com/locations/1514-the-shoppes-at-heritage-village)[Wegmans](https://www.wegmans.com/stores/wake-forest-nc) and[Harris Teeter](https://www.harristeeter.com/stores/grocery/nc/wake-forest/heritage-station/097/00043) , as well as local gyms and fitness studios like[O2 Fitness,](https://www.o2fitnessclubs.com/locations/nc/wake-forest)[Anytime Fitness](https://www.anytimefitness.com/locations/wake-forest-north-carolina-2706) and[Club Pilates.](https://www.clubpilates.com/location/wakeforest) When residents want to explore beyond the neighborhood, the greater Triangle provides even more options, from the restaurants and entertainment of[Downtown Raleigh](https://www.visitraleigh.com/plan-a-trip/cities-and-towns/raleigh/downtown-raleigh/) to the cultural attractions and experiences found throughout the region, like the[North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences](https://www.naturalsciences.org/) .


**Find Your Home at Everstead**


Thoughtfully designed with connection, comfort and everyday living in mind,[Everstead](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/everstead) by Tri Pointe Homes is a community built around the lifestyle potential homebuyers want to experience every day. From staying active by the pool and exploring nearby trails to connecting with neighbors through shared spaces and community amenities, every detail is designed to make life more enjoyable. With the perfect blend of natural wooded surroundings, modern conveniences and opportunities to build connections, Everstead offers more than a place to live, it offers a place to truly call home.
